aggregate_definitions.changed_tensor: state tensor differs exactly, including dtype; exact equality compares every value
aggregate_definitions.changed_element: number of element-wise unequal values; percentage denominator is all values in that category
aggregate_definitions.global_mean_absolute_difference: sum of absolute element differences divided by total elements
aggregate_definitions.global_l2_difference: square root of the sum of squared element differences across category
aggregate_definitions.global_relative_l2_difference: global L2 difference divided by global V7 L2 norm; null when V7 norm is zero
aggregate_definitions.mean_absolute_difference: per-tensor sum of absolute differences divided by tensor element count
